title: Can the harness merge similar pocket i answers?
hypothesis: A small multilingual embedding model plus one threshold chosen on separate calibration pairs can group paraphrases while keeping related, different, and opposing answers apart.

model.runtime: transformers mean pooling with attention mask, then L2 normalization

method: Choose one cosine threshold that maximises pairwise F1 on the frozen calibration pairs; break ties toward the higher threshold.
Connect two answers when cosine similarity is at least the frozen calibration threshold.
Predicted groups are connected components of that graph.
Do not use source, evidence, pocket id, gold group, or an LLM judge during clustering.
claim_boundary: Synthetic multilingual development test. It tests text grouping only. It does not test evidence quality, source independence, applicability, final-answer writing, scale, hostile inputs, or a phone build.
